# get-esim v1.0.2 Changelog

- Added new file: `.DS_Store`.
- Updated documentation to clarify that payment wallet addresses are provided dynamically by the API (do not hardcode payment addresses).
- Added details on API rate limiting (10 requests/min per IP, HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`).
- Removed hardcoded payment wallet addresses from public documentation tables.
- No core logic or functional changes; documentation and metadata update only.
